notes.title: Update #10
notes.content:
A couple of additional fixes and tweaks.

Firstly, as a response from player, Hairy Mary, I have reduced the mouse sensitivity by 50%. Hopefully, this will make for a smoother experience.

Level 01 - The Lost Valley
Flipped the notes around on both monoliths so that the player finds the note relating to collecting fairy rings and rock piles first.

Level 02 - The Swamplands
Fixed a disappearing and re-appearing bush

Level 07 - Snow Caves
Moved the exact respawn point to bring it next to the respawn marker

notes.title: Update #9
notes.content:
Firstly, an apology to players who have encountered an issue with the UI in the second level, The Swamplands.

Thanks to player, Hairy Mary for messaging me and pointing it out.

Long story short, in fixing a problem, I created another, namely forgetting to turn the level UI back on, which would result in no ESC menu and the UI collectable scores being invisible.

Silly mistake, so sorry if this has vexed any players. I've just updated now, and everything is above board again.

Thanks again Mary! ːrarebutterflyː

tags.bug: - Silly mistake, so sorry if this has vexed any players. I've just updated now, and everything is above board again.

notes.title: Update #8
notes.content:
Having watched all of StoryTeller Gaming's video
https://youtu.be/7WUSWR8mAjU?si=36hBrk_0gdo6fO_K

I spotted several mistakes that needed fixing

Level 01 - The Lost Valley
Removed a floating tree
Fixed a note typo
Added a ramp to certain rocks to avoid the player getting stuck

Level 02 - The Swamplands
Fixed a note typo

Level 03 - The Tunnels
Added collider to cave rocks to avoid player's head looking out of the map
Moved the rock in front of the secret maze to make it a little easier to find
Filled in a hole that enabled players to slip through the map and fall into......infinity!
Filled in a hole behind a waterfall that enabled players to slip through the map and fall into......infinity!

Level 04 - River Canyon
Added collider to cave rocks to avoid player's head looking out of the map

Level 06 - Swamp Canyon
Added a rock to cover a tiny hole in the rock face

Level 07 - Snow Caves
Added an ice ramp in the level to hint at the open cave area on the right

Thank you StoryTeller Gaming. Great video.

notes.title: Update #5
notes.content:
After watching ImSpi's video walkthrough of the demo
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LtcOaMpYHyk

I have added wildlife: various birds and numerous butterflies to the demo level.
Although in other levels of the game, I agree with the review insofar as it feels lacking this unique element. So thanks ImSpi. You've helped develop the game, hopefully for the better. ːrarebutterflyː
